# Japan

Region: Asia. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Japanese Banks Payment Clearing Network / Zengin-Net

**Role:** Domestic interbank clearing operator

**Reporting coverage:** ISO 20022 XML clearing / ZEDI adoption; CAMT052/053 profile not established

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022XML; exact CAMT types not verified

- [ZenginNet PFMI disclosure2025](https://www.zengin-net.jp/en/zengin_net/pdf/pfmi_disclosure_e_2025.pdf) — payment-guideline; public-file
- [ZenginNet system overview](https://www.zengin-net.jp/en/zengin_net/) — availability; public-page

PFMI principle 22 states that ISO 20022 XML messages were first optional in the sixth-generation system in 2011, and that ZEDI uses compliant XML. This supports domestic clearing and remittance infrastructure adoption, not a corporate account-statement standard.
